scope: CVG-003 bounded account-scoped discharge collection, detail, update and repository lookup/delete application boundary

criteria.description: Discharge hydration, refresh, collection, detail, encounter lookup, creation, update and cache removal require a valid AccountId; records are filtered before return or mutation and returned summaries are defensive copies.
criteria.limitations: The service cache is process-local; cross-process freshness is proven only through the tested authenticated route and disposable PostgreSQL composition.

criteria.description: In-memory and PostgreSQL detail, encounter, collection, update and delete operations use explicit account scope; PostgreSQL INSERT also requires the requested account to equal app.current_account_id(), and update atomically matches the previous version.
criteria.limitations: The direct integration uses the local test database administrative connection; a separately connected production runtime role remains an operational acceptance item.

criteria.description: Authenticated discharge GET/PATCH routes derive scope from the principal, PATCH rehydrates the account before detail/update, and two-account requests cannot disclose or mutate another account despite spoofed headers.
criteria.limitations: This is local HTTP-to-disposable-PostgreSQL evidence, not browser-to-target deployment evidence.

criteria.description: Failed speculative writes restore the prior cache, a failed queue does not poison later writes, command commit/rollback refreshes discharge/inpatient/audit caches, and concurrent repository updates produce one success and one conflict.
criteria.limitations: Full inpatient/discharge command atomicity still depends on the canonical tenant UoW; this gate does not claim arbitrary callers outside that wrapper.

criteria.description: TDD RED history is retained; corrected focused tests, full API regression, builds, typechecks, scoped lint, formatting, secrets scan and official coverage pass.
criteria.limitations: Coverage excludes designated database integration suites per the repository coverage command; aggregate lint and remote CI remain outside this bounded gate.

criteria.description: A fresh independent read-only follow-up review inspected the post-fix service, repositories, route, server recovery and tests and found no Critical, High or technical Medium blocker.
criteria.limitations: The initial review remains recorded as CONDITIONAL criticism evidence; the follow-up review did not run commands and does not replace target/runtime-role acceptance.

criteria.description: The bounded result is reconciled without promoting CVG-003, clinical parity, enterprise readiness or release; global partial/open metrics remain explicit.
criteria.limitations: General parity remains 98/100 with 4/11 verified, clinical parity 100/100 with 2/3 verified, and readiness 95/100 with 42 PASS, 3 WARN and 1 FAIL.

gaps: The HTTP and PostgreSQL evidence is disposable and does not certify target TCP/RLS or a separately connected production runtime role.
No HTTP DELETE route is part of this slice; repository delete scope is tested.
The optional encounter query/filter surface was not expanded.
Aggregate lint, remote CI, providers, browser accessibility, operations, backup/restore, remaining Vetus parity and release acceptance remain open.
conditions: Keep AccountId required at every discharge service and repository boundary.
Preserve principal-derived route scope, explicit active-account INSERT validation and atomic previous-version matching.
Revalidate before changing hydration, tenant context, transaction ownership, direct SQL, target, provider or production scope.

authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository-local discharge service/repository/route/test correction and local verification of account-scoped discharge boundaries; exclude migrations, direct privileged SQL, target, providers, credentials, production, deployment, external mutation and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before expanding beyond discharge application/repository/authenticated HTTP boundaries.

next_action: Keep CVG-003 and the global program IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL. Continue with the next separately authorized gap; do not promote this bounded result to clinical parity, enterprise readiness or release.
revalidation_triggers: New discharge collection, detail, update or delete path
Changes to hydration, tenant context, authorization, transaction ownership, inpatient transition ordering or discharge persistence
Expansion to target, provider, credential, production, deployment or release acceptance
